methods.description: Record kilometre andmetre distances usingkm andm withoutchanging their values.
Multiply the kilometre number by1000 torecord the same distance inmetres.
Divide the metre number by1000 torecord the same distance inkilometres.
Separate whole groups of1000metres from remainingmetres andrecord bothunits.
Change the kilometre part tometres andadd the remainingmetres,including two-section totaldistance.
Change distances to the sameunit before comparing orordering their numericalvalues.
Change the whole route tometres andsubtract the completedmetres.
